title: Joyedvanish
description: The only vanish plug-in you need!
body:
JoyedVanish – The Ultimate Vanish Plugin for Servers!

JoyedVanish is a lightweight, powerful vanish plugin designed for server staff, content creators, and admins who need true invisibility without the bloat.

 Features:
	•	/vanish – Instantly toggle vanish mode on or off
	•	Complete Invisibility – Become invisible to all players
	•	Tablist Removal – Disappear from the player list
	•	No Walking Particles – Move without a trace
	•	Permission-based Access – joyedvanish_vanish

Whether you’re moderating behind the scenes or recording content undisturbed, JoyedVanish gives you total stealth with just one command
